venue: Young Centre for the Performing Arts

venues: Young Centre for the Performing Arts

contact_edits.before: A Christmas Carol is worth the price just to see Joseph Ziegler's Ebenezer kicking off his slippers in an ecstasy of joyous reformation; his final rapprochement with Oliver Dennis's crown prince of Cratchits is a heart-warming bonus. Who knew being good could be so much fun? Ziegler's Scrooge is beautifully of a piece; the seeds of humour, if not of good humour, are sown in his early extravagant misanthropy, while his encroaching pain at the sight of opportunities past is very moving. Other welcome returning veterans are John Jarvis's quartet of spirits and Patrick Galligan's incorrigibly cheerful nephew, with Maggie Huculak as an assortment of wenches and crones. In terms of overall ensemble, CanStage cannot on this occasion be faulted. But Soulpepper has the soul. - It's a Wonderful Life runs until Dec. 20. Call 416-368-3110 for tickets and information. A Christmas Carol runs until Dec. 24. Call 416-866-8666.
